summary: Focused verification of two Conversation Trail branches after seed/guard update. Unlocked /alex with 'secret', cleared kodama-talk/v1/state, ran under prefers-reduced-motion. Read-only channel (Announcements) works correctly. Field Notes composer regression sanity works. Mara direct-talk renders 4 messages with correct clustering and trail-origin, BUT the unread firefly divider (data-testid='trail-new') is NOT rendered — root cause identified below.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='trail-new' divider does not render for Mara conversation despite conversation.unreadCount=2 and messages.length=4. Neither the [data-testid] nor the .trail-new class element exists in the DOM. Sidebar unread badge correctly shows '2', so seed data is loaded; the miss is in StreamView's ref bookkeeping.

rca of the issue: React.StrictMode is enabled (src/main.tsx). StreamView's mount useEffect runs twice in dev. The mock service's markRead() SYNCHRONOUSLY mutates the shared conversation object (mock-talk-service.ts:356-361: `if (c) c.unreadCount = 0` runs before the awaited delay). Sequence: (1) first effect run sets unreadAt.current = conversation.unreadCount (=2) and calls markRead → mutates the same object so conversation.unreadCount becomes 0 immediately; (2) StrictMode cleanup; (3) second effect run reads conversation.unreadCount (now 0) and sets unreadAt.current = 0. Subsequent render therefore never satisfies `unreadAt.current > 0`, so the trail-new divider is skipped. This does not reproduce in production (no double-invoke), but it breaks all dev previews and the current test environment. Recommended fixes (any one): (a) guard the ref so it is only ever set to the max seen value per conversation id: `unreadAt.current = Math.max(unreadAt.current, conversation.unreadCount)` keyed by id; (b) capture the initial unread count into local state on first fetch response instead of during the effect; (c) change mock markRead to not mutate in place synchronously — clone the conversation and defer the mutation until after `delay(undefined)`; (d) use useMemo/useState seeded from listMessages payload (return unreadAtIndex from the service).
action_items: Fix unread-divider ref so it survives StrictMode double-invocation. Preferred: in stream-view.tsx replace `unreadAt.current = conversation.unreadCount` with a per-conversation guard (e.g. track lastConvId ref; only assign when id changes AND value > current), OR keep the initial count in useState and reset only on conversation.id change.
Optionally, make mock-talk-service.markRead non-synchronous-mutating (delay before mutation) so shared conversation objects aren't zeroed while consumers still need the initial count.
critical_code_review_comments: stream-view.tsx line 44: `unreadAt.current = conversation.unreadCount` inside a `[conversation.id]` effect is fragile under StrictMode because markRead mutates the same conversation object synchronously. Use a per-id guard or derive from message payload.
mock-talk-service.ts markRead mutates a shared object before its await; consumers observing conversation.unreadCount get race conditions.
